apply_meta_description: Apply to be listed in the directory. No account needed. We review every application within 7 days.
apply_intro: No account needed. Tell us about your organization or about yourself. We review every application within {days} days and email you the decision.
apply_resubmit_intro: Your application was not approved. Fix what our email described and send it again.
apply_resubmit_expired: This link has expired, or the application was already deleted. You can send a new application.
apply_description_hint: Say what you do and who you work with. At least 20 characters.
apply_contact_email_hint: We confirm this address first, then send the decision here. After approval it is also the address of your account. It is not shown publicly unless you choose so later.
apply_tags_note: You can add tags after the listing is approved.
apply_consent_text: I agree that my full name, description, town and the other details I enter here are published in the public registry and can be found by search engines such as Google. My full name is part of the page address. After approval I can withdraw this consent in my account, or by email to the registry, and my listing is then unpublished at once. Photos are optional; if I add one, it is delivered through Cloudinary, which stores images in the United States (EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses).
apply_duplicate_unclaimed: already listed{place}. Open it to claim it instead of applying again.
apply_duplicate_owned: already listed{place} and has an owner.
apply_draft_restored: We restored your unsent draft from this device.
apply_website_invalid: Enter a web address that starts with http or https.
apply_location_required: Choose a country and a town.
apply_consent_required: Tick the box to agree before sending.
apply_age_required: Confirm that you are 16 or older.
apply_error_captcha: The security check did not pass. Wait a moment and send again.
apply_error_wait: The security check is still running. Wait a moment and send again.
apply_error_limit: Too many applications from this connection. Try again later.
apply_error_expired: This edit link has expired or was already used.
apply_error_generic: The application could not be sent. Your draft is kept. Please try again.
apply_sent_body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address. Only then does your application go to review. The link works for 7 days.
apply_received_body: Thank you. Your application is back in the review queue. We decide within {days} days and email you.
apply_verify_body: Confirm that this address is yours for the application {entryName}.
apply_verify_done_body: Your application {entryName} is now in review. We decide within {days} days and email you.
apply_verify_already: The application {entryName} is already confirmed. You will get an email with the decision.
apply_verify_invalid: This link is not valid or has expired. You can send the application again.
apply_error_retry: We could not send the form this time. Check your answers and press send again.
apply_error_invalid_town: Choose your town from the list again.
